description: Find pins close to another pin or to a map position, nearest first. Positions are in-game meters (x east, y north, matching map.gtadb.org); distances are in meters.

category.description: Only return pins in this category.

limit.description: Maximum number of pins to return, nearest first.

x.description: East-west map position in in-game meters (x grows east). Give both x and y to search around a point.

y.description: North-south map position in in-game meters (y grows north). Give both x and y.

name: find_nearby
title: Find nearby locations
